en: Outcome so far: {col:escalations.outcome}. State: {col:escalations.state}.
mt: 截至目前的结果:

en: Share the report with the PMO lead
mt: 与PMO领导人分享报告

en: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the risk score levels, review days, issue target days, change limits and the phones of the managing director and the PMO lead.
mt: 打开"开始",在黄色的单元格中输入公司名称和自己的限制:风险评分水平,审查日,发行目标日,更改限制以及总经理和PMO领导的电话.

en: Capacity of the active sprints on the Sprints sheet
mt: 在Sprint表上的活跃冲刺的容量

en: State of the sprint on the Sprints sheet
mt: 在Sprint表上的冲刺状态

en: Points a sprint left for bug fixing
mt: 指出一个冲刺剩下的bug修复

en: Sprints to clear the open bugs
mt: 冲刺清除开放的bug

en: Pick an epic and the share of the project velocity it gets; see the points left, the sprints to finish it, the forecast date and the target sprint set on the Epics sheet.
mt: 在Epic表上查看剩下的点,完成的冲刺,预测日期和目标冲刺.

en: Target sprint on the Epics sheet
mt: 在Epic表上目标冲刺

en: Hello {staff}, you have {assigned} points in sprint {number} of {project} and a capacity of {cap_points}. Please tell the project manager which item can move.
mt: 你好,你在冲刺 {number} 的 {assigned} 点 {project} 和一个容量 {cap_points}. 请告诉项目经理哪个项目可以移动.

en: Hello {assignee}, card {card_id} ({title}) on {project} is marked blocked. Please add the blocker to the Blockers sheet and tell us what you need.
mt: 您好,在 {project} 上的卡 {card_id} ({title}) 标记为被封锁.请将封锁器添加到封锁器表中,并告诉我们您需要什么.

en: Hello {assignee}, card {card_id} ({title}) has been in work for {age} days. Is it still on track? Please update the board or split the card.
mt: 你好,卡 {card_id} ({title}) 已经工作了 {age} 天.它还在轨吗?请更新板或分割卡.

en: Hello {staff}, the stand-up of {project} is at {time}. Please bring what you did yesterday, what you plan today and any blocker.
mt: 您可以带来您昨天做的事情,今天的计划和任何阻碍.

en: Hello {owner}, the retrospective action "{action}" is due on {due}. Please finish it or tell us what is in the way.
mt: 你好,回顾行动"{action}"是由于在{due}. 请完成它或告诉我们是什么.

en: Hello {keeper}, the {lane} column of {project} holds {cards} cards against a limit of {limit}. Please finish a card before you pull a new one.
mt: 你好, {keeper} 的 {lane} 列包含 {cards} 卡,限制为 {limit}.请在抽取新卡之前完成一张卡.

en: Hello {manager}, the velocity of {project} in sprint {number} was {done} points, trend: {trend}. Please talk about it in the retrospective.
mt: 你好,在冲刺中 {project} 的速度 {number} 是 {done} 点,趋势: {trend}. 请回顾一下.

en: Hello {manager}, blockers open too long on {name}: {old_blockers}. Please help the team remove them today.
mt: 您好,阻塞器开放时间过长. 请帮助团队今天移除它们.

en: Hello {sponsor}, you are invited to the review of sprint {number} of {project} on {demo_date}. We show {done_pts} finished points. Please confirm.
mt: 你好,我们邀请你参加在 {demo_date} 上 {project} 的冲刺 {number} 的回顾.我们显示 {done_pts} 完成的分数.请确认.

en: Hello {sponsor}, in the review of sprint {number} of {project} the client accepted {accepted} of {done_pts} points. Next step: {next_step}.
mt: 您好,在 {project} 的冲刺 {number} 审查中,客户接受了 {accepted} 的 {done_pts} 分. 下一步: {next_step}.

en: Hello {sponsor}, at a velocity of {velocity} points the open backlog of {name} is done on {forecast_date}. Sprints left: {sprints_left}.
mt: 您好,在 {velocity} 点的速度下 {name} 的开放积累在 {forecast_date} 上完成.左跑: {sprints_left}.

en: Hello {client_contact}, the refinement session of {project} is on {date}. Please bring your priorities so that we can order the backlog together.
mt: 您好, {client_contact} 的改进会在 {date}. 请带来您的优先事项,以便我们一起整理积压.

en: Hello {client_contact}, points of sprint {number} of {project} waiting for your acceptance: {to_accept}. Please accept them or tell us what to change.
mt: 你好,我们正在等待您的接受:请接受它们或告诉我们要改变什么.

en: Hello {client_contact}, new work in sprint {number} of {project} means something of the same size must leave. Which item should move?
mt: 你好,新工作在冲刺 {number} 的 {project} 意思是同样大小的东西必须离开. 哪个项目应该移动?

en: Hello, we plan the next sprints of {name}. How many developer days can {vendor} give from the start of the next sprint? Please answer this week.
mt: 你好,我们计划下一个冲刺.从下一个冲刺开始,开发人员可以给出多少天?请回答本周.

en: Hello {facilitator}, the retrospective of sprint {number} of {project} is on {held_on}. Earlier actions still open: {open_actions}. Please start with them.
mt: 您好,我们已经开始了我们之前的行动.

en: PMO lead: board over its limits
mt: PMO领先:董事会超过了其限制

en: Sprint goal: {col:sprints.goal}.
mt: 冲刺目标:

en: A plan above {set:over_pct} of the capacity needs work taken out before the sprint starts. A plan below {set:under_pct} leaves room for another item from the ready backlog.
mt: 超过 {set:over_pct} 的计划需要在冲刺开始之前完成工作.

en: Project: {col:projects.name}. Client contact: {col:projects.contact}. Project manager: {col:projects.manager}.
mt: 项目: 客户联系人: 项目经理:

en: The release is planned for sprint {col:releases.sprint_no} ({col:releases.target_sprint}). The state against its date is: {col:releases.state}.
mt: 发行计划为sprint {col:releases.sprint_no} ({col:releases.target_sprint}). 状态与其日期相比是: {col:releases.state}.

en: Project: {col:retros.project}. Sprint {col:retros.number}, held on {col:retros.held_on}. Facilitator: {col:retros.facilitator}.
mt: 项目: {col:retros.project}. 冲刺 {col:retros.number},举行在 {col:retros.held_on}.

en: What went well: {col:retros.went_well}.
mt: 什么是成功的:

en: Epic status note for the client
mt: 客户端的Epic状态说明
